description: Offizielles Verzeichnis der Strassen Liechtenstein is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Amt für Tiefbau und Geoinformation. Offizieller Datensatz für das «Verzeichnis der Strassen». Das Verzeichnis der Strassen beinhaltet sämtliche offiziellen und damit behördenverbindlichen Strassen von Liechtenstein. Grundlage für das offiziellen Verzeichnis der Strassen bildet die amtliche Vermessung. Coverage: Amt für Tiefbau und Geoinformation. The portal files it under the publisher Amt für Tiefbau und Geoinformation. It offers 3 resource(s) in HTML, WMS. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
